title: Outstanding preachers
summary: Henry names Jim Jones as an outstanding country preacher and comments on preachers and money.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: The march tempo was small, but the burges were low. Yeah. That's how I see it. Did you ever hear any outstanding preachers for funerals? Any men who really were supposed to be good? Any men who really were supposed to be good?
Yes. What do you mean in the country? Either in the country or here?
Yeah. Outstanding preachers in the country.
I told them by the name of Jim Jones, he was an outstanding preacher.
Well, what makes a preacher outstanding with him, and what does he do?

Well, I'm going to tell you, if he's outstanding, he can stand upon his own. You can get anywhere you can stand and do, you can get this for work and any other man do all the more. He just gets through with the people more.
That's that side. What are they, outstanding preachers talk loud or soft or what?
Some of them. They're getting their head turned, I guess, like me sometimes. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know.
Ever hear of sunshine money? I would.

How many times have I heard it? I really want these. These two are too sassy for me. They jump up and tell them women what they got to do, bring them money, and they don't care where they get it from.
That doesn't sound like a preacher. That sounds like something else .
Yeah . That doesn't want to . How did he get much for him . Mm-hm .
